title: list views: read an absent `userActions.editInline` as on (`editInline !== false`), the consumer half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22605 (the v18 default flip)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22605

Filing gate: **③ the consumer half of a contract-first split.** Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18883, `session_01KNKBCRDJCu5tGy3TEbvtrF`), which claimed the spec half (`6094254055`), as triage's grade on that card directs (`6093968052`): "The claiming seat files it as the contract-first follow-up, with `Blocked-by:` this card." ⛔ Not a claim. Triage grades and routes it here.

## The ruling

The maintainer, verbatim (filed on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22605 by the director seat): 「乙 v18 把 spec 默认翻成 true,editInline: false 变成关法。」

A list view is editable in place by default, under the permission gate that already exists. An author who wants a read-only list declares `userActions: { editInline: false }`. The rule of #5144 stands: one vocabulary, the `inlineEdit` fold, declared = enforced. Only the default's value changes.

## What changes here (located on objectui `main`; line numbers are pointers)

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: `inlineEditOffered` (the "Gap 2" docblock, about `:1975`) reads an absent `userActions.editInline` as the spec default, which becomes on: `editInline !== false`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx:571`: `inlineEdit: userActions.editInline === true` becomes `!== false`, and the comment at `:569` ("default off") is corrected.
- The fold in `packages/core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts` is unchanged: `inlineEdit: true` reads on and opens in edit mode; `inlineEdit: false` reads off; an explicit `editInline` wins.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`: the table gains the row "neither key: offered, opens out of edit mode".
- The pins flip: `ListView.permissions.test.tsx`, `normalize-list-view.inlineEditFold-5144.test.ts`, and the interface-page tests.
- The console's toggle stays session-only (#5144, ruling E). The ADR-0047 interface page gains the toggle by default, as the maintainer accepted.
- ⛔ The permission gate is untouched: the toggle is offered only when the object is editable in place and the principal can `update` it (`ListView.tsx` about `:2007`).

## Order

objectstack-ai/objectstack#22605 lands first. This card needs no new export from `@objectstack/spec`: it reads `editInline !== false`. Its landing waits for that card, not for the install face. In the window objectui still reads an absent key as off, so nothing regresses against today.

## Acceptance

- A grid view that declares nothing offers the inline-edit toggle to a user with `update` on the object, and not to a user without it.
- `userActions: { editInline: false }` removes it, and `inlineEdit: true` still opens the grid in edit mode.

Dedupe: titles of objectui's 39 open issues (REST list) matched for `editInline`, `inline edit` and `5144` → 0 hits. Dedupe words: editInline default true · inline edit offered by default · list view read-only opt-out
